summary: Tested BTI PWA backend (12 pytest cases) and frontend UI end-to-end in simulator mode. All backend endpoints (/api/health, /api/config, /api/status, /api/modo, /api/manual, /api/setpoints) work correctly, including hysteresis validation, range validation, and the auto-mode hysteresis logic (temp>=on => fan/led ON, temp<=off => OFF). Frontend UI fully functional: StatusBanner muestra 'Simulador activo' con dot verde pulsante, MetricCards muestran valores font-mono, Mode toggle cambia entre auto/manual, Control buttons alternan ON/OFF y quedan disabled (opacity-40 grayscale) en modo auto, SetpointsForm valida histéresis y muestra mensajes correctamente, SettingsModal abre como bottom sheet, toggle Simulador habilita/deshabilita input IP, IP inválida muestra error, Footer disclaimer presente.
critical_code_review_comments: Simulator is a singleton in memory - state is shared across all clients and resets only on backend restart. This is acceptable for a demo/PWA but worth noting.
useStatus polling every 2s keeps running even when the tab is backgrounded; consider visibility API to pause polling and save requests.

SettingsModal: onClose is called after save with a 350ms timeout via setTimeout; if the modal unmounts before the timeout fires, the closure still tries onClose - not a real leak but could be tightened.
Validation IP regex in /app/frontend/src/lib/validation.js permite puertos 0 si no hay 4 grupos, pero al no haberlos la condición is OK. Edge case menor.
seed_data_creation: Ninguna - el endpoint /api/config crea el documento default automáticamente si no existe.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest está en /app/backend/tests/test_bti_api.py. Polling del frontend es cada 2s y refresca /api/status. Modo simulador es un singleton en memoria, por lo que las pruebas que modifican modo/setpoints deben restaurar el estado al final (el autouse fixture restablece simulator=true e modo=auto). El app está diseñado con max-w-[430px] mobile-first; usar viewport 430x900 para pruebas visuales.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found. All features listed in the request work as specified.
